maya-cs: Quick weekly health ping for Helio Health — wanted to flag a model-mix shift and rising fallback rate observed this week.

maya-cs: TL;DR: newvariant (v2-small) uptake ~40%, v3-base ~35%, legacy v1 -> 25%. Fallbacks up to 6.8% on peak hours (00:00-02:00 PST). Latency p50 ~210ms, p95 ~980ms. Spend +13% vs last week.

sam-ops: Noted. Any correlation with traffic pattern changes or prompt length?

maya-cs: Early signal looks like longer contexts from one power user segment (avg tokens/session +18%). Also they rolled the new variant via canary last Tue.

leo-ml: Can confirm from model side — v2-small has higher CPU bursts with longer seqs. We see increased KV-cache misses when seq > 1024.

leo-ml: Quick snippet from our query sample: ```user_prompt_tokens: 1100 -> cache_miss_rate: 0.42```

maya-cs: Fallbacks are mostly to v1 (legacy) due to runtime OOM on dedicated nodes. Fallback-to-legacy explains slight quality drop reported by customer.

anna-am: Customer called this morning — worried about latency spikes and higher bill. Mentioned potential renewal sensitivity if spikes continue. Asking for mitigation plan.

sam-ops: Ops suggestions: 1) temporarily limit seq length for v2-small via routing policy, 2) enable auto-burst to Dedicated pool during night window, 3) short-term increase node mem on their Dedicated reservation.

leo-ml: Also recommend a quantized variant (v2-small-q8) for longer contexts — lower mem footprint. We can prepare an A/B with controlled rollout.

maya-cs: Action items: @leo-ml prepare v2-small-q8 artifact and perf numbers by EOD Thu; @sam-ops scope quick routing rule to cap seq at 1200 tokens for v2-small and add burst policy; @anna-am I'll send the customer a note with temporary mitigations and ask for permission to run A/B.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy | helio/newvariant/v2-small -> started by leo-ml at 2026-03-20T08:12:10Z :rocket:

sam-ops: Also scheduling a short on-call window tonight to watch fallback rate after the routing change.

maya-cs: Thanks. I'll include these in the weekly health digest and set a renewal risk flag to "monitor" until fallback <= 2% for two consecutive days.

anna-am: Sounds good — please cc me on the customer update.

leo-ml: Will do. If we see persistent OOMs, we'll throttle attention-based layers as fallback option.

maya-cs: Ok team — check-ins tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
